NATO Intern Arrested in Belgium on Spying Suspicion

A Canadian national of Chinese origin, identified as an intern at NATO headquarters in Belgium, has been arrested on suspicion of espionage. The arrest occurred in Belgium, where the intern was reportedly working. The specific nature of the alleged spying activities and the extent of the information compromised have not been detailed in the coverage.
